one_scan_read.completion_clock: worker host monotonic immediately after FFI returns, before encoding or optional diagnostics

host_attempt_pacing.boundary: worker HOST monotonic timestamp immediately before FFI attempt
host_attempt_pacing.owner: worker monotonic next-admission frontier; parent RPC time is only a hint
host_attempt_pacing.next_frontier: current admitted attempt_start + interval, checked addition
host_attempt_pacing.early: healthy idle, no SDK and no frontier advance
host_attempt_pacing.initial_ready: no attempt and no interval consumption; first Read may be immediately eligible
host_attempt_pacing.slow_read: one eligible attempt after an overshoot; no catchup burst and no completion+interval throttle
host_attempt_pacing.deadline: all waits and Read use the same original operation deadline and cutoff; no renewal
not_claimed: ADC timing, uniqueness or simultaneous channels
host_attempt_pacing.fixture_clock_law: Assert ordered worker attempt/frontier transitions and causal C-entry/return brackets. Do not impose a load-sensitive exact physical C-entry interval law.

measurement_first_scan_controls.units_control: Identical words under requestedC/F are not locally converted.

measurement_first_scan_controls.units: amps, identical under builtin/external shunt; no V/R or mA conversion

publication_policy.hardware_rate_and_buffer_fields: omitted, not null; no nominal/requested hardware rate or input buffer claim
publication_policy.sample_index: returned scans in this owned epoch, not hardware conversions or loss sequence
publication_policy.outer_clock: actual post-Read host completion; no interpolation or device-time claim
publication_policy.repeat_words: retained without dedup, freshness or loss inference

publication_policy.partial_error: accepted one-scan negative prefix and original raw native code precede optional deferred diagnostics; hung Finish cannot erase prefix
